responsibility: Provides canonical type-operation queries used by the compiler to ascribe user types, prove predicates, and normalize several kinds of values (`Ty`, `Clause`, `FnSig`, and `PolyFnSig`). It defines the shared normalization helper, registers the corresponding obligations in an `ObligationCtxt`, and exposes the provider implementations along with the predicate-proving helper used for diagnostics-sensitive reruns.
